title: arenaria serpyllifolia subsp. viscida
intro: Arenaria serpyllifolia subsp. viscida, commonly known as Sticky Sandwort, is a subspecies of the Arenaria serpyllifolia plant, belonging to the Caryophyllaceae family. It is a low-growing, mat-forming perennial herb with small white or pink flowers that has been used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Sticky Sandwort include its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been traditionally used to treat wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities.
